Trabajamos con equipos multidisciplinares para ofrecer soluciones creativas y eficientes en cada obra. Valoramos la formación continua y la incorporación de talento joven que quiera aprender del sector de la construcción. Como parte de nuestro crecimiento, buscamos personas que aporten nuevas ideas en mercadotecnia para fortalecer nuestra presencia en el mercado.

Descripción del puesto Como Estudiante de mercadotecnia en Bpro Construye, apoyarás al equipo en la planificación y ejecución de campañas de marketing orientadas al sector construcción. También participarás en la organización de eventos y presentaciones para clientes, así como en tareas administrativas relacionadas con el área de marketing. Este es un puesto de prácticas, de jornada completa o parcial según convenio, que se desarrolla de forma presencial en Santiago, NLE.

Estar cursando estudios de mercadotecnia, comunicación, administración de empresas o carreras afines.

description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Join our Pricing Team in Mexico, where you'll optimize prices to boost key metrics and enhance user experience. You'll develop playbooks, frameworks, and tools while collaborating with operations teams to execute impactful strategies. This role is perfect for someone passionate about influencing business outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

In this role, you'll be...


Work on the region’s pricing strategy;
Create frameworks to improve decision-making;
Analyze data to understand user behavior, generating actionable insights;
Develop methodologies to optimize pricing decisions;
Collaborate with different areas like operations, marketing, product, and growth



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in engineering, economics, business, data science, or a related field.

Skills: Proficiency in Excel and SQL; strong communication and stakeholder management; analytical problem-solving with strategic thinking; data-driven decision-making.

Work Style: Adaptable and proactive, thriving in ambiguous environments; hands-on approach to experimenting and executing projects.

Languages: Professional proficiency in English and Spanish.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
𝗤𝘂𝗶𝗲́𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝘀𝗼𝗺𝗼𝘀




En Creatif construimos el cerebro de IA que opera a una empresa, y luego lo operamos. Tenemos dos marcas:




• 𝗖𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗳: para empresas medianas. Les construimos empleados digitales y un cerebro que administra su organización. Sus canales van en inglés.

• 𝗚𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗗: para negocios pequeños. Un gerente digital que lleva lo operativo, lo administrativo y el crecimiento, desde WhatsApp. Sus canales van en español, para México y Colombia.




Somos un equipo pequeño y remoto que trabaja por metas, en México, Colombia y Reino Unido.




𝗤𝘂𝗲́ 𝘃𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗰𝗲𝗿




𝗤𝘂𝗲 𝗻𝗼𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗼𝘇𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝘆 𝗻𝗼𝘀 𝗲𝘀𝗰𝗿𝗶𝗯𝗮𝗻 (𝗹𝗮 𝗺𝗮𝘆𝗼𝗿 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗲 𝗱𝗲 𝘁𝘂 𝘁𝗶𝗲𝗺𝗽𝗼)




• Llevar las redes de Creatif (inglés: LinkedIn e Instagram) y de GerenteD (español: Instagram, Facebook y TikTok).

• Hacer reels que la gente vea completos: grabar, editar, ganchos, subtítulos, tendencias.

• Convertir lo que funciona en anuncios y llevar la pauta en Meta y Google.

• Que cada conversación que llegue se vuelva un lead para el equipo comercial.




Platicar de 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘁𝗵 con 𝗻𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗼𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝘀




• Llevar el taller de arranque con cada cliente de GerenteD Growth, donde definimos con ellos sus pilares de comunicación.

• Llamadas cortas de seguimiento con cada cliente.

• Revisar y aprobar el contenido que producen nuestras herramientas de IA.

• Un reporte mensual claro: qué se publicó, qué funcionó, qué sigue.




𝗟𝗼 𝗾𝘂𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝘀𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗼𝘀




• Vives en Colombia o México.

• Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito: vas a escribir y grabar para Creatif en inglés.

• 2 años o más llevando redes de una marca o de clientes, con reels que tú grabaste y editaste.

• Campañas en Meta Ads con presupuesto real; sabes leer el costo por lead. Google Ads suma.

• Criterio y sentido del humor: contenido divertido que también vende.

• Gusto por hablar con dueños de negocio.

• Usas herramientas de IA en tu trabajo, o quieres usarlas todos los días.

• Suma: salir en cámara, CapCut o Edits, Canva, experiencia en tecnología o startups.




𝗟𝗼 𝗾𝘂𝗲 𝗼𝗳𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗼𝘀




𝗦𝘂𝗲𝗹𝗱𝗼 𝗳𝗶𝗷𝗼




• 𝗖𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗶𝗮: $4.000.000 COP al mes durante la prueba de 3 meses y $4.500.000 COP al pasarla.

• 𝗠𝗲́𝘅𝗶𝗰𝗼: $22,000.00 MXN al mes durante la prueba de 3 meses y $25,000.00 MXN al pasarla.




𝗩𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲, 𝘀𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗼𝗽𝗲




• 𝗕𝗼𝗻𝗼 𝗽𝗼𝗿 𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲 𝗻𝘂𝗲𝘃𝗼 que llegue por tus canales, pagado en sus primeros 3 meses de pago: $265.000 COP / $1,500.00 MXN por cada negocio de GerenteD, y $890.000 COP / $5,000.00 MXN por cada empresa de Creatif.

• 𝗕𝗼𝗻𝗼 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗹, 𝗶𝗴𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗾𝘂𝗲 𝗲𝗹 𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼 𝗱𝗲𝗹 𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗽𝗼: medio mes de tu fijo al 85% de la meta, un mes al 100% y mes y medio al 150% o más. El 70% depende de la meta de la empresa y el 30% de tus propias metas.




𝗨𝗻 𝗲𝗷𝗲𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗼: si por tus canales entran 4 negocios nuevos de GerenteD al mes, en tu primer año sumas, además del fijo:




• 𝗖𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗶𝗮: unos $10.600.000 COP en bonos por cliente.

• 𝗠𝗲́𝘅𝗶𝗰𝗼: unos $60,000.00 MXN en bonos por cliente.

• 𝗦𝗶 𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗮́𝘀 𝗲𝗹 𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗽𝗼 𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗴𝗮 𝗮 𝗹𝗮 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗮 𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗮 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗲, el bono trimestral suma 4 meses de tu fijo al año. Un cliente de Creatif suma bastante más.




𝗕𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗶𝗼𝘀




• 𝗩𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗰𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗲𝘀 𝗳𝗹𝗲𝘅𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲𝘀, 𝘀𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗼𝗽𝗲: las coordinas con el equipo. Te pedimos tomar al menos 15 días hábiles al año, para que descanses de verdad.

• 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗷𝗮 𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗱𝗲 𝗱𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗲 𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘀, con tu propio horario, por metas.

• 𝗦𝗲𝗴𝘂𝗿𝗼 𝗺𝗲́𝗱𝗶𝗰𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗮𝗱𝗼 al pasar la prueba (en Colombia, medicina prepagada).

• 𝗘𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗽𝗼 𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗱𝗲 𝗲𝗹 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗿 𝗱𝗶́𝗮: teléfono para grabar, micrófono, luz, CapCut y Canva Pro, y presupuesto de pauta.




𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗼 𝘆 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼




• 𝗟𝗼𝘀 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗿𝗼𝘀 𝟯 𝗺𝗲𝘀𝗲𝘀, por servicios profesionales (en México, honorarios; en Colombia, prestación de servicios).

• 𝗔𝗹 𝗽𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗿𝗹𝗼𝘀, 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗼 𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗹 con todas las prestaciones de ley de tu país.

• 𝗖𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗼 𝗮 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘁𝗵 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗱: al cumplir tus metas dos trimestres seguidos, subes a Growth Lead, con su aumento de sueldo, participación en la empresa y gente a tu cargo conforme crezca el equipo. La meta es que llegues en la segunda mitad de 2027.




𝗖𝗼́𝗺𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗿




Antes de aplicar, conócenos: creatifinc.com, gerented.com y sentinel.boutique.




Manda:




1. 𝗧𝘂 𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗳𝗼𝗹𝗶𝗼: enlaces a las cuentas que llevas o llevaste (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn) y qué hiciste tú en cada una.

2. 𝟯 𝗿𝗲𝗲𝗹𝘀 𝗵𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗼𝘀 𝗽𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗶 (grabados y editados), en enlace o archivo.

3. 𝗨𝗻𝗮 𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗻̃𝗮 𝗾𝘂𝗲 𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗮𝘀 𝗹𝗹𝗲𝘃𝗮𝗱𝗼: objetivo, presupuesto y resultado. Una captura del administrador de anuncios suma.

4. 𝗨𝗻 𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗼 𝗱𝗲 𝟭 𝗺𝗶𝗻𝘂𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝗻 𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗹𝗲́𝘀, grabado con tu celular: What is the first reel you would make for Creatif, and why? Usa las herramientas que quieras para pensarlo; queremos verte explicarlo.

5. 𝗧𝘂 𝗖𝗩 o tu perfil de LinkedIn.




𝗘𝗹 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗰𝗲𝘀𝗼




1. Revisamos tu portafolio.

2. Llamada de 30 minutos, con una parte en inglés.

3. 𝗣𝗿𝘂𝗲𝗯𝗮 𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗽𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗱𝗮, 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗮 𝗹𝗮𝘀 𝟯 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗮𝘀 𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘀: en 5 días hábiles nos mandas 2 reels (uno de GerenteD en español y uno de Creatif en inglés) y la propuesta de una campaña: público, mensaje, presupuesto y cómo medirías el resultado. Te pagamos $265.000 COP / $1,500.00 MXN, quedes o no. La prueba es solo para conocer cómo trabajas: se queda contigo y no la usamos.

4. Llamada final con el equipo.

description:
Acerca de Kavak

Somos la empresa de tecnología que está revolucionando la compra y venta de autos usados en Latinoamérica desde el 2016. Después de 7 años de funcionamiento, Kavak se ha convertido en la startup tecnológica más valorada de América Latina, formalizando el negocio de autos usados en mercados emergentes,con operaciones en México, Brasil, Argentina, Chile y Medio Oriente.




Actualmente, estamos buscando nuevos talentos que les apasionen los retos y tengan hambre por crear soluciones que impacten positivamente la vida de millones de personas con opciones seguras, justas y accesibles para adquirir el auto de sus sueños. Nuestra misión es potenciar la vida de las personas a través del acceso a un automóvil. Desbloqueamos el poder transformador que tiene un auto para que las personas puedan simplemente disfrutar del viaje.




Nuestro equipo es la prioridad número uno. Nos encanta imaginar lo imposible y trabajar juntos para lograrlo. Somos disruptivos, proactivos, leales y ambiciosos.




Tu Misión

Buscamos un perfil analítico de Growth Marketing con foco principal en Paid Media, que entienda el funnel completo y sepa leer datos para tomar decisiones de inversión. Vas a trabajar codo a codo con un equipo distribuido en LATAM y partners cross-funcionales (Producto, Data, Martech, Brand) para escalar la adquisición de usuarios en México.




¿Qué vas a hacer? 

Guiar al equipo y coordinar con partners cross-funcionales (Producto, Data, Martech, Brand, etc) para llevar iniciativas de la idea a producción.




Paid Media (foco principal)

Ejecutar y optimizar la estrategia multicanal (Meta, Google, TikTok), con foco en eficiencia de CAC/ROAS.
Colaborar en la estrategia de value-based bidding y su implementación como señal de conversión en las plataformas.

Analytics

Monitorear el framework de KPIs (Inversión, CPM, CTR, CAC, ROAS, conversión) y construir lectura accionable.
Apoyarse en Amplitude, GA4 o herramientas similares para leer resultados más allá de las plataformas de paid.
Participar en la agenda de experimentación (A/B testing).

Colaboración

Coordinar con partners cross-funcionales para llevar iniciativas a producción.




¿Qué estamos buscando?

2-3 años de experiencia en growth, performance o marketing digital, idealmente en marketplace, e-commerce, fintech o tech de alto crecimiento.
Licenciatura en Administración, Ingeniería, Economía, Mercadotecnia o afines.
Manejo de plataformas de paid media (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads).
Conocimiento funcional de SQL (que entienda y pueda leer una query, no requiere nivel avanzado).
Experiencia con herramientas de analytics de producto (Amplitude, GA4 o similar).
Inglés avanzado.




Mindset

Bias hacia la acción, cómodo en entornos con recursos ajustados y cambio constante.
Colaborativo, ownership sobre resultados.




Suma puntos

Conocimiento de atribución/server-side tracking.
Experiencia con equipos distribuidos.




Si te apasiona la disrupción junto con una excelente ejecución, te encantan los desafíos y tomar decisiones basadas en datos y estás orientado a la misión, ¡KAVAK es el lugar para ti!

title: Líder de Estrategia de Marketing Digital
description:
Lider de Estrategia de Marketing Digital




Somos una empresa mexicana, fundada en Culiacán, Sinaloa. En 2021 cumplimos 80 años mejorando la vida de millones de mexicanos. Tenemos presencia en todos los estados de la república y contamos con más de 139 mil colaboradores, lo que nos convierte en uno de los 10 principales empleadores del país. Nuestro modelo de negocio está conformado por una amplia oferta de productos y servicios comerciales y financieros que operan transversalmente bajo el ecosistema omnicanal, lo que significa que podemos tener acceso a nuestros clientes por varios medios como:




Tiendas Coppel

BanCoppel

Afore Coppel

Ambiente digital (.com y apps)




Coppel es una comunidad en donde la dignidad humana prevalece sobre cualquier otra condición, por ese motivo, apoyamos la inclusión, la diversidad y la igualdad de oportunidades, sin hacer diferencia por raza, lugar de origen, religión, creencias, edad, imagen, orientación sexual, identidad de género, discapacidad, etc.




Propósito:




Apoyarte en tus necesidades y deseos, acercándote un mundo de posibilidades para que mejores tu vida.




Valores:




Confianza

Responsabilidad

Atención y Servicio

Eficiencia y Sencillez

Innovación




Objetivo del Puesto:




Asegurar e implementar la estrategia de campañas de marketing digital para alcanzar los objetivos de las categorías y unidades de negocio a las que da servicio para lograr el éxito de las campañas generando ventas y posicionando a Grupo Coppel en el mercado.




Responsabilidades:




• Definir y dar seguimiento al calendario operativo de campañas para mejorar los indicadores claves de cada unidad de negocio.




• Colaborar con el equipo de cliente para el desarrollo de segmentaciones avanzadas aplicadas a los casos de personalización para alinear y unir los esfuerzos logrando campañas digitales exitosas




• Conocer e investigar las tendencias del mercado y la competencia para mejorar nuestra estrategia de campañas digitales.




• Establecer indicadores claves para medir el desempeño de las campañas digitales y presentar los resultados periódicamente.




• Coordinar la optimización de las estrategias de las campañas de marketing que permitan alcanzar las metas establecidas por la gerencia nacional para alcanzar las metas de venta




• Garantizar el cumplimiento de las metas en conjunto con sus clientes internos para buscar posicionar a Grupo Coppel en el mercado e incrementar las ventas.




Escolaridad:




Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Economía, Administración, Sistemas y Desarrollo, Multimedia e Ingeniería Industrial




Experiencia:




3 años Estrategias de Marketing Digital en eCommerce o página de servicios digitales, campañas de Marketing Digital o especialista de CRM o email Marketing en empresas nacionales/ internacionales o agencias de publicidad




Conocimientos/Habilidades:




Métricas online (en especial de e-mail marketing) para analizar y optimizar las eficiencias de las campañas.

Google Search Console, Google My Business




Ofrecemos:




Prestaciones de ley y superiores

Reparto de Utilidades (PTU)

Becas para estudios académicos, computación o idiomas (colaborador y familia directa)

Fondo de Ahorro para el retiro

Descuentos exclusivos en tienda

Seguro de gastos médicos menores

Seguro de Vida

Planes de carrera con cursos, capacitaciones y certificaciones constantes

Incentivo por término de estudios

Útiles para tus hijos en edad escolar




STAFF - PJR

title: Senior Marketing Manager - Mexican Market
skills: De 7 a 10 años de experiencia en marketing, con al menos 2 años liderando equipos.
Experiencia en B2B SaaS, HR Tech o tecnología para empresas en México.
Experiencia en generación de demanda: campañas, contenido y métricas de pipeline (MQL, SQL, pipeline influenciado), trabajando de la mano con Ventas y Demand Global.
Experiencia en product marketing o go-to-market: posicionamiento, mensajes, lanzamientos y sales enablement.
Manejo de presupuesto y gestión de agencias de PR y digital, así como de proveedores (eventos, exteriores).
Manejo de CRM (HubSpot) y herramientas de analítica.
Inglés avanzado para trabajar con el equipo global.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos globales o en compañías multinacionales, llevando estrategias globales a un mercado local.
Tienes red de contactos en medios de negocios y en la comunidad de RRHH en México.
Conoces el contexto laboral mexicano (reforma laboral, NOM-035, cultura laboral local) y sabes convertirlo en conversación de marca.
Tienes pensamiento estratégico y, al mismo tiempo, capacidad de bajar a la ejecución.
Estás orientado/a a datos y a resultados de negocio.
Disfrutas liderar y desarrollar personas.
Eres hábil en la negociación y gestión de stakeholders internos, externos y globales.
Tienes criterio de marca y storytelling.
Combinas autonomía y proactividad con visión global: propones ideas nuevas y sabes sacarle partido a lo que ya funciona.
Definir junto con Marketing global la estrategia y el plan anual de marketing para México.
Adaptar el posicionamiento de Sesame al mercado mexicano y priorizar dónde invertir con base en datos.
Sacar el máximo partido a las herramientas y metodologías de Sesame (CRM, atribución, reporting) y proponer cómo adaptarlas y mejorarlas para el mercado mexicano.
Impulsar la marca de Sesame en México a través de eventos, PR, contenido y comunidad.
Co-liderar con Demand Gen y Ventas la generación de pipeline.
Llevar el product marketing local: posicionamiento, lanzamientos y materiales para Ventas.
Gestionar el presupuesto de marketing México, así como agencias y proveedores.

Ser el puente entre Marketing global y los equipos de México (Ventas, Producto, Customer Success y People): impulsar que todos aprovechen al máximo nuestro modelo y llevar la voz del mercado mexicano a global.
Definir y medir KPIs clave (pipeline, salud de marca y retorno de la inversión) apoyándote en el reporting global de Sesame.
Liderar y desarrollar a un equipo de dos personas (Brand y Contenido).

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, information systems, design, human-computer interaction, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience

First 90 Days

Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short- and long-term goals

Six Months


Establish an agreed framework for priority web journeys, including audience definitions, journey stages, owners, key experience requirements, and success measures

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

description:
About us




We build AI agents for manufacturing. Allie integrates intelligence into factory operations: learning from machines, sensors and systems to detect problems, recommend actions and coordinate responses in real time. Our platform connects to PLCs, MES and ERPs through secure edge gateways. It transforms raw data into operational decisions that improve availability, quality and throughput. We work with large manufacturing groups in the food, beverage and CPG industries deploying AI agents that embed into production lines and scale across sites. Allie is built to act, not just report. From real-time monitoring to autonomous control, we help your factory think and self-optimize.




Sales, rebuilt as an engineering discipline. One operator, one agent stack, the entire revenue machine — for an AI company selling into the factory floor.




FULL-CYCLE · AI-NATIVE · BUILD THE MACHINE, OWN THE NUMBER




01 · THE THESIS




This role didn't exist three years ago




The old playbook — hire SDRs, buy twelve tools, pray the CRM stays clean — is being replaced. In its place: one or two operators who build the machine instead of being the machine.




They map the ICP and TAM programmatically. They watch every named account for signals and react the same day. They run outbound, inbound, events, and deal support as maintained systems, not repeated tasks. They spawn agents that verify their own output and loop until the outcome is achieved. And they do it for a fraction of what the equivalent sales-tool stack costs.




The profile is scarce: full-cycle sales fluency, technical instinct, and AI-native operation rarely live in the same person. This charter exists because Allie runs GTM this way — and is looking for the operator who wants to own it.




02 · THE ROLE




One operator, the entire top-of-funnel




Allie sells an operational copilot to Tier-1 manufacturers. The buyers are plant directors, VPs of operations, and CTOs at global brewers, food producers, and CPG companies — people who don't respond to spray-and-pray. They respond to precision.




This is not an SDR job and not a marketing job. It is one operator running the entire acquisition machine as a system: every list, every signal, every sequence, every call, every event, every piece of reporting — designed, automated, and maintained by you, with Claude Code and a small set of external APIs doing the work a six-person growth team used to do.




You own the number that matters: qualified hand-offs to technical sales. Everything below exists to feed it.




03 · WHAT YOU OWN




Six systems, one owner




SYS 01 · ICP & data foundation

Map the full ICP and TAM: the named-account universe for brewing, food & bev, and CPG manufacturing across US, Mexico, and LATAM
Build signal-based and lookalike lists off closed-won accounts; refresh continuously, not quarterly
Track every champion who changes jobs and route them as a new account
Own CRM architecture and reporting — pipeline truth lives here, and it is your truth to keep clean



SYS 02 · Signals & real-time reaction

Watch named accounts for tech-stack changes, funding, layoffs, headcount swings, new plant announcements, and expansion CapEx — and react the same day
De-anonymize website traffic, score it against closed-won, and push qualified visitors into sequence



SYS 03 · Outbound engine

Set up and maintain the mail infrastructure — domains, warm-up, deliverability
Build and run multi-touch sequences across email and LinkedIn
Build the cold-calling engine: parallel dialing at scale — calls running back-to-back with no dead time, the next account queued while the current call is live, every outcome written straight into CRM. Calling is a throughput problem, and you engineer the throughput
Score every inbound against past closed-won and auto-route qualified leads to technical sales
Re-engage closed-lost on a systematic cadence



SYS 04 · Inbound & content

Build the inbound system end to end: content filtered for the ICP, distributed across LinkedIn, amplified through a creator/operator network
Own content management and the publishing cadence — a visible calendar, a pipeline from draft to published, a rhythm that doesn't skip weeks
Run focused AEO efforts so Allie is the answer when a plant director asks an AI "how do I cut unplanned downtime"



SYS 05 · Events — an owned motion, not a side project

Own the event calendar for the ICP — several shows are already locked for this year; you run those end to end and build the calendar forward from what they produce
Pre-event: named-account target list per show, booking sequences 4–6 weeks out, meetings landed before the doors open — a booth with no calendar is a cost center
On-site: every conversation captured into CRM same-day with context, not badge scans
Post-event: 100% of captured contacts in sequence within 48 hours; qualified ones handed off within a week
Report pipeline generated per event and kill the events that don't pay for themselves



SYS 06 · Deal support & feedback loops

Auto-build a pre-call brief for every meeting on the calendar
Generate the one-pager, ROI model, and proposal inputs per deal
Analyze sales calls and feed patterns back into sequences, content, and qualification criteria
Manage the sales collateral library — decks, one-pagers, case studies — versioned, current, and findable, so no one ever ships a stale asset



04 · HOW YOU WORK




Local-first. Agent-native. Human judgment on every send.




You build local-first. Every workflow starts on your own machine with Claude Code — no platform dependency, no waiting on anyone else's roadmap. If a workflow needs a platform to exist, it doesn't exist yet. As workflows prove out, they migrate into Rooster, Allie's internal GTM agent, so the engine becomes a company asset, not a laptop. Local Claude Code is where you build; Rooster is where it lands.




Every workflow is a system you build once and maintain, not a task you repeat. You spawn subagents that verify their own output, you loop until the outcome is achieved, and you treat "I did it manually" as a bug report against your own tooling.




Nothing client-facing auto-sends. You review and approve every external touch. Automation buys you volume; judgment is still the job.




05 · WHO YOU ARE




Three non-negotiables

TRAITWHAT IT MEANS HEREFull-cycle sales fluencyYou understand the whole cycle — prospecting through close through expansion. You've carried a number, or sat close enough to one to feel it.Technical by instinctYou can read an API doc, reason about a data model, and debug your own workflow at 11pm before a launch. You may not call yourself an engineer; you build like one.Al-native operationYou run AI as an operating discipline — agents that verify their output, loops that run until the outcome is achieved, workflows that cost a fraction of the equivalent SaaS stack.




Strong signals: you've built a growth system solo that a team later inherited; you've sold into manufacturing, industrial, or another long-cycle technical buyer; you've worked an event circuit and can show pipeline per show, not photos of the booth.




06 · THE FIRST 30 DAYS




The engine gets built. All of it.




Not phased, not sequenced, not "foundations first." By day 30, every system above is live: ICP universe in CRM, signal watching running, mail infrastructure warm and sequences shipping, the calling engine dialing, inbound pipeline producing, event calendar locked with meetings booked, pre-call briefs generating for every calendar meeting. Built locally with Claude Code, migrating into Rooster as each workflow proves out.




From day 31, the conversation is results. The measurement framework already exists — a weekly growth scorecard, built and run by the CRO, with qualified hand-offs and closes as the north star. You don't design the measurement system; you feed it.




07 · WHERE THIS GOES




The machine you build becomes the org you run




This role grows into technical sales leadership: managing both the growth function and the technical-sales AEs who carry deals from demo to close. The path is direct — first you build the acquisition machine, then you own the people and the machine together.




Most companies split this work across six tools and four people. Here it is one operator, one agent stack, and full ownership — and the ceiling on the role is whatever you make the machine capable of.

El Marketing Digital Lead es el responsable de la estrategia digital integral de las cuentas. Define cómo las marcas se comportan, crecen y generan impacto en el ecosistema digital — desde la arquitectura de contenido hasta la supervisión de la pauta — asegurando que cada decisión responda a un objetivo de negocio claro.

Su rol conecta dos mundos que suelen operar por separado: el contenido y el performance. Supervisa que el Content Studio produzca con criterio estratégico, y coordina con el Performance Lab para que la pauta amplifique lo que el contenido ya está demostrando orgánicamente.

No ejecuta en detalle — dirige. Define el marco, establece los objetivos digitales por cuenta, supervisa al equipo de contenido y es el interlocutor técnico-estratégico con el proveedor de performance.




Responsabilidades clave1. Estrategia digital por cuenta

Definir la estrategia digital integral de cada cuenta: canales, objetivos, KPIs, formatos y fases.
Traducir los lineamientos del Head of Strategy en planes digitales accionables y medibles.
Establecer el ecosistema digital de cada marca: qué plataformas, con qué voz, con qué frecuencia y con qué propósito.
Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento digital dentro de las cuentas existentes.

2.  Content Studio

Dirigir al Content & Social Media Lead en la planeación y ejecución editorial.
Revisar y aprobar calendarios de contenido, territorios editoriales y propuestas de formato.
Asegurar que el contenido producido responda a objetivos digitales claros y no solo a criterios creativos.
Ser el filtro estratégico entre la narrativa del Brand Strategist y la ejecución del equipo de contenido.

3. Coordinación con Performance Lab

Definir junto al Performance Lead los objetivos de pauta, audiencias y KPIs por campaña.
Asegurar que los materiales de contenido lleguen en tiempo y forma al equipo de performance para su activación.
Revisar resultados de campañas pagadas e integrarlos a la estrategia de contenido orgánico.
Ser el puente entre la narrativa de marca y la eficiencia de la pauta: lo que funciona orgánicamente informa lo que se paga.

4. Analítica y toma de decisiones basada en datos

Supervisar el monitoreo de métricas digitales por cuenta: alcance, engagement, conversiones, costo por resultado.
Interpretar datos para ajustar estrategias, redirigir presupuestos y optimizar formatos.
Generar reportes estratégicos digitales con visión ejecutiva para el cliente y para el CVO.
Implementar cultura de medición en el equipo de contenido: cada pieza tiene un objetivo, cada objetivo tiene una métrica.

5. Innovación y tendencias digitales

Monitorear cambios de algoritmo, nuevos formatos y tendencias de plataforma que impacten la estrategia de las cuentas.
Proponer pruebas, experimentos y nuevos formatos que mantengan a las marcas relevantes y competitivas.
Evaluar herramientas digitales que mejoren la eficiencia del equipo y la calidad de los entregables.

6. Nuevos negocios

Participar en el desarrollo de propuestas digitales para pitches y nuevos clientes.
Aportar visión de ecosistema digital, benchmarks y proyecciones de resultados en procesos de venta.
Construir casos de éxito digitales que posicionen a la agencia como referente en comunicación digital estratégica.

Competencias clave

Visión estratégica digital: capacidad de diseñar ecosistemas, no solo campañas.
Liderazgo de equipo creativo: dirigir con criterio, no solo con instrucciones.
Pensamiento analítico: leer datos y convertirlos en decisiones estratégicas.
Conocimiento técnico de plataformas: dominio de Meta, TikTok, Google, LinkedIn y sus lógicas de distribución.
Comunicación ejecutiva: presentar estrategia y resultados digitales con claridad a clientes y dirección.
Criterio narrativo: evaluar si una estrategia digital está alineada con la marca, no solo si es efectiva en métricas.
Adaptabilidad: operar con agilidad en un entorno digital en constante cambio.

Métricas de desempeño

Crecimiento digital por cuenta (alcance, engagement, seguidores, tráfico).
Eficiencia de pauta: costo por resultado vs. objetivos definidos por campaña.
Cumplimiento y calidad de la estrategia digital aprobada por el cliente.
Alineación entre contenido orgánico y performance pagado.
Satisfacción del cliente sobre la dirección y resultados digitales.
Desempeño y desarrollo del equipo bajo su supervisión.

Perfil del candidato

Licenciatura en Marketing, Comunicación, Publicidad, Administración o carrera afín.
5 a 7 años de experiencia en marketing digital, preferentemente en agencia o entorno de múltiples cuentas.
Dominio de ecosistemas digitales: estrategia de contenido, social media, pauta digital y analítica.
Manejo de herramientas: Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Ads, plataformas de gestión de contenido.
Experiencia liderando equipos creativos o editoriales.
Inglés avanzado — nivel profesional escrito y oral.
Perfil estratégico, orientado a resultados, con capacidad de moverse entre el pensamiento y la ejecución.

Manukora is a certified B Corporation, working with locally-based master beekeeping partners to produce the highest quality Mānuka, leading through ethical beekeeping practices and investing in our bees, their environment and the communities that surround them.

description:
Location: Remote - LATAM

Type: Contractor

Salary: $2,800 - $3,200 per month, depending on experience

About Us

eJam is a bootstrapped consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands — all without ever taking a dollar of outside capital. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We're not a startup hoping something works. We're a team that has done it repeatedly — taken products from idea to category leader, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small team, no bureaucracy, massive ownership.

This is the place where you'll see the entire machine — sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail — all under one roof. If you want to learn how consumer products actually get built and shipped at scale, there is no faster education than this.

The Role

We're looking for an Email Retention Designer to design the emails that keep our customers coming back. You'll design daily campaigns and automated flows for two consumer brands, keep our templates and email guidelines fresh, and own one brand's email calendar. We work like a performance marketing team, so the pace is fast and some emails are needed the same day. This is a hands-on execution role: no direct reports and no strategy ownership. You'll report to our Retention, Subscription & Lifecycle Manager and work closely with our Email Retention Analyst, who builds your designs in the email platform.

What You'll Do


Design campaigns and flows: design daily campaign emails and automated flow emails (welcome, post-purchase, win-back and more) for two brands
Own a brand calendar: keep one brand's email calendar on track and on time
Propose copy: suggest copy refreshes and new angles for headlines, heroes and CTAs
Templates and guidelines: update email templates and keep brand guidelines current so every send is consistent
Track performance: follow CTR and revenue per recipient on your designs and use them to improve the next email
Hand off clean files: deliver organized Figma files and exports ready to build



Requirements


3-6 years designing emails, or designing for consumer brands with email as a core part of the work
Figma: it is your main tool and you are fast in it
Email design experience: you have designed campaign and automated flow emails that went live, and you can show them
Agency or consumer brand background: ideally you come from a performance marketing or email/retention agency, or from an in-house team at a consumer brand
You know what makes an email work: logo, hero, a clear CTA, supporting content and footer, built on a brand guideline
Fast turnaround: you are comfortable with a fast cadence, including same-day email requests
Portfolio required: include a link to a portfolio with emails you designed yourself
English and schedule: working-level English and daily overlap with US Pacific Time mornings



Nice to Have


UI/UX design experience
Klaviyo experience
DTC or subscription brand experience
Copywriting skills



Compensation


$2,800-$3,200 USD per month, depending on experience



Benefits


What We Offer


100% remote: work from anywhere within LATAM, with daily overlap with US Pacific Time (PT) mornings
Long-term engagement with a profitable, growing company
Direct access to leadership and real ownership of your work
Exposure to the full consumer products machine across multiple brands
Learning & development opportunities


Why eJam


We build and scale category-leading eCommerce brands
We operate with speed, ownership, and accountability
Ideas move quickly from concept to execution
Every team member has direct impact on company growth
We value operators who think strategically and execute decisively


Equal Employment Opportunity

eJam is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and respected. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

We believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our ability to serve our customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Head of Performance Creative
skills: Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.

Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.

Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.

Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.

Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.
Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.

Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.

High-Tempo Work Ethic (50+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 50+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.
Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.
description:
Role Objective

AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel. Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.

You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.

What You’ll Do


Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.

Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.


Required Skills And Qualifications


Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
High-Tempo Work Ethic (50+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 50+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.


Working Hours & Culture


Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.


How To Apply & What To Expect

At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

description:
Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

As a Customer Success Manager - Mexico, you will report to the Director, Customer Success, and be the face of Motive to our customers within Mexico. The CSM ensures that the customer realizes value from our solutions, helping customer leadership drive adoption and providing guidance in best practices around the use of our solutions. The CSM will take accountability in helping customers and internal cross functional teams find solutions to any issues that arise during the complete lifecycle of the customer using our solutions.

What You'll Do


Own a book of business with existing customers for expansion and renewals
Ensure consistent retention of revenue and renewal of all accounts
Own adoption, training, and development of best practices
Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and nurture client health
Identify paths for the customer to realize value from the entire Motive platform
Help customers navigate our internal processes, including support tickets. 
Help customers to escalate support issues correctly if needed 
Handle a large volume of email, chat, and phone conversations
Work with the sales team and Implementation Consultants to ensure a seamless handoff

3+ years prior experience in a customer-facing role
2+ years prior experience as a CSM or equivalent (owning a renewal target)
Bilingual fluency in Spanish and English required
Ownership of revenue and renewals for a named book of business
Experience working with accounts based in both Mexico and US a plus
Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and their key personnel
Receptive to feedback, willingness to learn and embrace continuous improvement
Resilient in capacity to deal with pressure and the demands of a fast-paced workplace
Ability to plan ahead and be resourceful
Strong sense of ownership for the product
Logistics experience is a big plus
Prior sales experience a plus

title: Customer Success Manager - Core
skills: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion for Salesforce Marketing Cloud applications.
Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
Help your Sales, Service or Marketing Cloud customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer.
Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer’s implementation
Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
The CSM may be required for occasional travel to customer sites and may need to be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.

+5 years work experience in one or more of the following: Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.Demonstrated expertise of 2+ years within the Salesforce Ecosystem, specifically in Sales, Service or Marketing Cloud, including comprehensive knowledge of its product features, capabilities, optimal use cases, and strategic deployment.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies
Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects
Available for a flexible schedule, 3 days in-office.

Knowledge of Salesforce Core products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy are a plus.Salesforce Certifications (Salesforce Certified Platform Foundations, Salesforce Certified Platform AdministratorCloud Admin, Marketing Cloud Consultant or similar)
Knowledge and certifications in Data Cloud and Agentforce.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile Core and Marketing Cloud customers.

You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer’s key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents.

The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to going above and beyonds, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Your Impact


Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion for Salesforce Marketing Cloud applications.
Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
Help your Sales, Service or Marketing Cloud customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer.
Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer’s implementation
Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
The CSM may be required for occasional travel to customer sites and may need to be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.


Minimum Requirements


 +5 years work experience in one or more of the following: Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.Demonstrated expertise of 2+ years within the Salesforce Ecosystem, specifically in Sales, Service or Marketing Cloud, including comprehensive knowledge of its product features, capabilities, optimal use cases, and strategic deployment.
 Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
 Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.
 Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
 Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies
 Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects
 Available for a flexible schedule, 3 days in-office.


Preferred Requirements


Knowledge of Salesforce Core products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy are a plus.Salesforce Certifications (Salesforce Certified Platform Foundations, Salesforce Certified Platform AdministratorCloud Admin, Marketing Cloud Consultant or similar)
Knowledge and certifications in Data Cloud and Agentforce.


Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.




The Role

As a Customer Success Specialist, you will manage relationships with professors and librarians at universities across North America, proactively communicating JoVE's value and encouraging faculty to adopt and integrate JoVE resources into their courses.

This is a post-sales, customer-facing role focused on building relationships, driving product adoption and usage, and ensuring institutions maximize the value of their existing JoVE subscriptions. The ideal candidate is proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a metrics-driven environment.

description:
Traild: Who are we?  
Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

About
Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role
As Traild accelerates its expansion across North America, we are looking for an Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager to own the full implementation journey for our most complex, high-stakes enterprise clients. This is a newly dedicated enterprise-focused role, created because enterprise implementations demand a different level of rigor, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination than mid-market work. You will sit within the Customer Success team and collaborate daily with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product to get clients live and, more importantly, to ensure they adopt Traild in a way that delivers lasting value. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will come in as the first Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager in the region, with real ownership from day one.

Key Responsibilities


Drive enterprise implementations ($100K+ ACV) from scoping through to go-live and beyond, maintaining momentum across long and complex project timelines with multiple concurrent accounts
Own the end-to-end client journey from onboarding through to successful adoption, ensuring customers achieve measurable value
Provide user training, technical support and troubleshooting throughout implementation and beyond
Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product daily to work through client-specific issues, surface product feedback and keep implementations moving without unnecessary delays
Build trusted relationships with enterprise stakeholders and decision-makers, managing expectations clearly and maintaining CSAT above 90% across your portfolio
Own your personal KPIs including go-live targets, adoption outcomes and client health metrics, and contribute actively to internal documentation and process improvement
Drive momentum in complex or ambiguous customer environments, keeping implementations on track without needing to escalate




Who You Are
You are an experienced implementation professional who has worked directly with enterprise clients in a B2B SaaS environment and knows what it takes to get complex projects across the line without losing sight of the longer-term adoption outcome. You bring a confident, consultative approach and thrive in fast-moving environments where you need to problem-solve, prioritise and own your outcomes with limited hand-holding.

Must have


Strong project management skills — owning scoping, timelines, risk management and driving outcomes independently
Solid technical aptitude, comfortable working across integrations, workflows, and partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, especially with senior and executive-level stakeholders
Comfortable operating in a startup or scale-up environment where processes are still being built and the pace of change is high
Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit




Nice to have


5–7 years of direct enterprise-level implementation experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a strong preference for AP, accounting or fintech software
Familiarity with ERP or payment related platforms, particularly IFS, Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP B1 or SYSPRO




We know great implementation people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.

Location & Language Requirements 
This role is open exclusively to candidates based in Canada, Mexico or Colombia. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in the United States at this time.

Given the global nature of our business and the customers you'll be supporting, candidates must demonstrate advanced English language proficiency (CEFR C1 level or above), with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Salary Range
The base salary range for this position is:



Canada: $90,000–$110,000 CAD per year
Mexico and Colombia: Competitive, market-aligned compensation based on local salary benchmarks




Compensation is determined based on experience, education and geographic location. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s qualifications and prevailing market conditions in their location.

The Perks of Working at Traild



Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options.  
Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world.  
We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it

title: ABM Manager - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.




Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.




When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.




ABM Manager at BairesDev




In this role, you'll be the closest partner our commercial teams have inside Growth Marketing, working daily with US-based sales and account leaders. This is a hands-on individual contributor position that blends account-based campaign execution with building the AI-powered automations that tell sellers exactly when to act. This is your opportunity to shape how data and AI directly drive new deals and account expansion, using tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.




What You'll Do:




- Plan and run account-based campaigns for target and existing accounts across email, LinkedIn messaging, LinkedIn Ads, and direct mail, coordinated with each account's sales owner.

- Map commercial processes with sales and account teams and build automations (CRM, Clay, n8n/Make/Zapier, LLM steps) that detect account signals and alert sellers when to take action.

- Build and maintain the data behind these programs, including target-account lists, buying committees, and enriched account and contact records in CRM portals.

- Report weekly to commercial leaders on outcomes, including meetings booked, opportunities created, deals accelerated, accounts expanded, and revenue influenced.

- Test new channels and plays beyond the core four, such as event follow-up, video, or retargeting, and scale the ones that move pipeline.




What we are looking for:




- 2+ years running account-based marketing (ABM) programs in direct partnership with sales or account management teams, including co-selecting target accounts, building joint account plans, and reporting account-level pipeline or expansion to sales leaders.

description:
Analista de Marketing y Reclutamiento Estudiantil | Marketing and Enrollment Officer

Ciudad de México | Tiempo completo, trabajo remoto

Se requiere dominio oral y escrito de español e inglés.




Acerca de Alexander College




Alexander College es una institución privada de educación superior con sede en Vancouver, Columbia Británica, Canadá. Recibimos a estudiantes canadienses e internacionales y ofrecemos programas de grado asociado, cursos con opción de transferencia de créditos a universidades e inglés con fines académicos. Nuestra Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas con especialización en Gestión de Negocios Digitales (Bachelor of Business Administration in e-Business Management) dura cuatro años, aborda el uso de la tecnología digital y la inteligencia artificial en las empresas e inicia con su primera generación en enero de 2027. Nuestro equipo de asesoría académica ayuda a los estudiantes a planear sus estudios y a conocer opciones para continuar su formación.




Acerca del puesto




Buscamos a una persona con base en Ciudad de México para ampliar nuestra red de agencias educativas y escuelas en todo México. El puesto es remoto y de tiempo completo. Desarrollarás alianzas, generarás contactos calificados y darás seguimiento a estudiantes y familias durante el horario laboral de Ciudad de México, con horarios acordados para reuniones con el equipo de Vancouver.




Responsabilidades




• Desarrollar relaciones con agencias educativas y escuelas en México. Informar a sus asesores sobre los programas y requisitos de admisión y dar seguimiento a los estudiantes que refieran.

• Generar contactos calificados mediante presentaciones en escuelas, seminarios en línea, ferias y actividades locales autorizadas. Dar seguimiento a las iniciativas que generan solicitudes.

• Responder oportunamente por teléfono, correo y canales de mensajería autorizados. Usar el CRM y, cuando corresponda, herramientas de seguimiento asistidas por IA. Orientar a los solicitantes sobre programas, trámites y documentos pendientes. Coordinar cartas de admisión, depósitos, inscripciones e inicio de clases con Admisiones, Finanzas y Servicios Estudiantiles.

• Mantener actualizado el registro de contactos y solicitudes en el CRM. Reportar tiempos de respuesta, contactos calificados, solicitudes completas e inscripciones por fuente. Detectar solicitudes estancadas y proponer prioridades de seguimiento.

• Proteger los datos de los solicitantes, seguir los procedimientos de privacidad y consentimiento, usar los canales oficiales para trámites y pagos y canalizar las preguntas de inmigración a profesionales autorizados. Evitar prometer admisiones, transferencias de créditos o resultados de trámites de visa.




Requisitos




• Al menos dos años de experiencia en reclutamiento estudiantil, admisiones, marketing educativo, ventas consultivas o un área afín.

• Estudios de nivel superior o experiencia profesional equivalente.

• Dominio oral y escrito de español e inglés. El español se utiliza para la atención local y el inglés para coordinar con el equipo canadiense.

• Experiencia con CRM y seguimiento de varios contactos por teléfono, correo y mensajería.

• Residir en Ciudad de México y estar disponible en horario laboral local, con disponibilidad para reuniones acordadas con Vancouver.

• Se valoran la experiencia en educación superior canadiense, el conocimiento del sistema educativo de Columbia Británica y las relaciones con agencias educativas mexicanas.




Cómo postularte




Envía tu currículum y una breve presentación, ambos en inglés. Indica en qué mercados has trabajado, una alianza educativa que ayudaste a desarrollar y un resultado medible de reclutamiento o seguimiento. No incluyas datos personales de estudiantes.

description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

As Product Manager - Immunology, you will lead the commercial strategy and life-cycle management for assigned Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease products within the Immunology portfolio. The role is responsible for developing and executing product strategies that deliver sales and margin targets, accelerate market access, and ensure sustainable competitive positioning. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate clinical and market insights into actionable plans.

Key Responsibilities

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


Brand strategy: Own the end-to-end brand strategy for Immunology and Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease products, including the launch of a new indication. Develop and implement the Brand Plan and Long-Range Plan, covering commercial and demand planning, forecasting, resource allocation, risk and opportunity identification, and Advertising and Promotion budget management. Monitor product performance through quantitative and qualitative metrics, identify gaps, and lead corrective action plans to improve outcomes.
Market analysis: Conduct market analyses using audits, primary and secondary research, and field intelligence to identify pain points and unmet needs among clinicians, patients, payers, and healthcare administrators. Convert findings into actionable commercial insights.
Segmentation and positioning: Develop patient journeys, healthcare professional behavioural segmentation, customer targeting, and omnichannel strategies. Identify barriers to patient identification, diagnosis, referral, and treatment initiation. Translate market insights and clinical evidence into clear positioning, differentiated value propositions, messages, campaigns, and integrated customer engagement plans.
Strategy execution: Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, business cases, and implementation plans with measurable objectives and key performance indicators. Drive field execution by partnering with, coaching, and aligning the sales force to support the correct implementation of the strategy, timely tactical adjustments, and effective field engagement.
Market access: Accelerate private- and public-sector market access in collaboration with the Market Access, Regulatory, and Health Economics and Outcomes Research teams.
Cross-functional enablement: Ensure strategic alignment across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Sales, Regulatory, Finance, and other enabling functions. Resolve dependencies and drive timely decisions through cross-functional influence, without relying on formal authority.


Why You?

Basic Qualifications

We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals


Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
